review_scope: Focused prior-art scan, not a systematic review. Abstract-level limits are retained.

sources.title: Value of information and decision pathways: Concepts and case studies
sources.supports: Information acquisition has costs; value depends on use in decisions.
sources.does_not_support: No estimate of the value of this protocol or any proposed energy experiment.

sources.title: NIST: What is experimental design?
sources.supports: Experimental design specifies planned changes and observed effects.
sources.does_not_support: No validation of this proposed pilot or sample size.

sources.title: Center for Open Science: Preregistration
sources.supports: Prespecifying a plan distinguishes planned tests from exploration.
sources.does_not_support: Preregistration alone does not guarantee sound hypotheses or results.

sources.title: When combinations of humans and AI are useful
sources.supports: The authors report heterogeneous effects and average losses against the better solo participant in the included studies.
sources.does_not_support: No direct test of our protocol or energy-domain performance. Full paper not evaluated; publisher page retrieval failed.

sources.title: Should we be going MAD? A Look at Multi-Agent Debate Strategies for LLMs
sources.supports: The authors report evaluated debate methods did not reliably outperform other prompting strategies, with sensitivity to tuning.
sources.does_not_support: No universal rejection of debate or proof of performance in this project; full paper not evaluated.

sources.title: W3C PROV Overview
sources.supports: Existing standards describe provenance entities, activities and agents.
sources.does_not_support: Our lightweight graph is not claimed to implement or conform to PROV; provenance does not establish truth.
